explanation: Enqueue onto one list-backed stack. When the dequeue stack is empty, reverse all pending entries into it, so popping returns FIFO order. Each entry transfers once.
timeComplexity: O(1) amortized per operation; O(n) worst-case transfer/resize
spaceComplexity: O(n) logical queue storage, plus Python list capacity
